title: Phone app: a one-tap Status update button

requirements.text: The Talk screen has a Status update button that sends the Assistant a status request with one tap, no typing
Tapping it on the phone gets Tally's status reply back on the phone
requirements.check: eye: TJ taps Status update on the phone and a reply arrives

evidence: MainActivity.kt AssistChip 'Status update' sends STATUS_REQUEST via link.say

text: Built and emulator-tested: chip sends request, reply arrives. Only req 3 left: TJ taps it on the real phone with Tally.
Status update lives in the top bar, left of the speaker button, as a text button with no icon
user_said: i wanted it at the top, center or to the left of the audio button? at the bottom looks like the agent gave me a file called 'status update'

evidence: TJ: "yes all are great!" (after installing 0.1.449041 and trying Stop, Status update, notifications)

answers.observed: Emulator: chip tap sent STATUS_REQUEST and a reply came back in the chat; moved to top bar per TJ; TJ: all are great
answers.cause: Uses the existing link.say path; nothing new on the laptop side
answers.absence: Not checked: whether a long status label like 'Tally is working…' gets cut short next to the button on a 360dp phone
answers.assumption: A canned prompt to Tally is what TJ wants, rather than the Status tab's overview (my choice); TJ approved the result
answers.falsify: Tapping it while disconnected or while waiting: the button is disabled in both states
